title: NK live test results: UC-5 and UC-7

environment.Server: `cramberry_server` from `backend/out/build`, one server on port 8102 with `CRAMBERRY_AUTO_REPLAN=0`, test students on UTC-6
environment.Client: Python 3 `urllib`, one request at a time

cases.title: Generate a conflict-free weekly plan
cases.requirement: UC-5 Generate AI Study Schedule, FR-16 (AI builds daily and weekly study schedules from tasks, deadlines and availability)
cases.inputs: Study preferences (PUT /api/settings/preferences, Study Settings page): free Saturday Nov 28 and Sunday Nov 29 4-7 PM. Class Saturday Nov 28 5-6 PM entered as personal time. 60 min sessions, 15 min breaks, 180 min a day. Tasks: Math Quiz 1 hr due Sunday Nov 29 10 AM, CS 3354 Project 2 hrs due Sunday Nov 29 11:59 PM. Generate New Plan is POST /api/agent/generate, then the calendar is reloaded with GET /api/schedule.
cases.expected: Study blocks fit available hours and occur before deadlines. None overlap the class. Accepted plan appears on calendar.
cases.actual: 200, engine claude-haiku-5.5, warnings none, 2.5 s. Saved blocks Math Quiz Sat 4 PM-5 PM, CS 3354 Project Sat 6 PM-7 PM, CS 3354 Project Sun 4 PM-5 PM; minutes {'Math Quiz': 60, 'CS 3354 Project': 120}; rule problems none; study_blocks rows match.

checks.check: generate answers 200
both saved tasks get study blocks
every block is inside the free hours, before its deadline, off the class hour, with no overlaps
calendar after reload shows the plan that was returned
study_blocks rows in Supabase match the calendar

cases.title: Insufficient time before deadline
cases.requirement: UC-5 Generate AI Study Schedule, FR-16 (AI builds daily and weekly study schedules from tasks, deadlines and availability)
cases.inputs: Accepted plan first: free Sunday Nov 29 4-7 PM, task Existing task 1 hr due Sunday Nov 29 11:59 PM, generated and saved. Test availability then saved: free Saturday Nov 28 4-5 PM and Sunday Nov 29 4-7 PM. Task Physics Exam Prep 4 hrs due Sunday Nov 29 9 AM, so the only free time before its deadline is Saturday Nov 28 4-5 PM. The saved plan is the calendar right before Generate, after the rebuild that saving preferences starts. Generate is POST /api/agent/generate.
cases.expected: System reports that 4 hrs cannot fit in the 1-hr free window and requests changed constraints or workload. No overlapping block is accepted; saved plan stays unchanged.
cases.actual: 200, engine local, messages "claude-haiku-5.5: "Existing task" is not scheduled Only 60 of 240 min for "Physics Exam Prep" fit before it is due". Plan before Existing task Sat 4 PM-5 PM, Existing task Sun 4 PM-5 PM; after Physics Exam Prep Sat 4 PM-5 PM, Existing task Sun 4 PM-5 PM.

checks.check: the answer says Physics Exam Prep does not fit before its deadline
the answer asks for more study time or less work
no overlapping or out-of-hours block is saved
saved plan is unchanged (API)
saved plan is unchanged (study_blocks rows)

cases.title: Reject reversed availability hours
cases.requirement: UC-5 Generate AI Study Schedule, FR-16 (AI builds daily and weekly study schedules from tasks, deadlines and availability)
cases.inputs: Accepted plan first: free Sunday Nov 29 4-5 PM, task BIO Lab 1 hr due Sunday Nov 29 11:59 PM, generated and saved. Then study availability Saturday Nov 28 from 7 PM to 4 PM added and saved with PUT /api/settings/preferences (the Study Settings grid cannot paint a reversed range, so the request is sent as the page would send it), then POST /api/agent/generate, then preferences and calendar reloaded.
cases.expected: Validation explains that end time must be after start. Invalid hours are not saved or used for generation; the accepted plan remains intact.
cases.actual: Save 400 "Study hours must end after they start"; generate 200. Saved hours ['Sun 16:00-17:00']; plan before BIO Lab Sun 4 PM-5 PM, after BIO Lab Sun 4 PM-5 PM.

checks.check: save is rejected with 400
message says the end time must be after the start
reloaded preferences have no hours on the invalid day
study_preferences row in Supabase is unchanged
no block uses the invalid hours
accepted plan remains intact after the generate attempt

cases.title: Sync tasks, calendar, and AI schedule
cases.requirement: UC-5 Generate AI Study Schedule, FR-16 (AI builds daily and weekly study schedules from tasks, deadlines and availability)
cases.inputs: Tasks saved with POST /api/tasks (Tasks page): ENG 1301 Essay 90 min due Sunday Nov 29 11:59 PM, CS 3354 Lab 60 min due Saturday Nov 28 11:59 PM. Fixed class Saturday Nov 28 4-5 PM entered as personal time. Free Saturday Nov 28 and Sunday Nov 29 4-7 PM. Generate is POST /api/agent/generate, then GET /api/tasks and GET /api/schedule as the reload.
cases.expected: Generated study times account for both tasks and their deadlines, do not overlap the Saturday Nov 28 4-5 PM class, and remain visible after reload. Task deadlines are unchanged.
cases.actual: 200, engine claude-haiku-5.5. Blocks after reload CS 3354 Lab Sat 5 PM-6 PM, ENG 1301 Essay Sat 6:15 PM-7 PM, ENG 1301 Essay Sun 4 PM-5 PM, ENG 1301 Essay Sun 5:15 PM-6:15 PM; minutes {'CS 3354 Lab': 60, 'ENG 1301 Essay': 165}; rule problems none; study_blocks rows match.

checks.check: generate answers 200
ENG 1301 Essay gets at least its 90 min and CS 3354 Lab at least its 60 min
every block is before its task's deadline, inside free hours, off the class hour, with no overlaps
blocks are visible after reload and match study_blocks rows
task deadlines unchanged (API)
task deadlines unchanged (tasks rows)

cases.title: Answer a saved task question
cases.requirement: UC-7 Interact with AI Chatbot, FR-20 (chatbot answers questions about assignments and schedules)
cases.inputs: Saved task CS 3354 Project due Sunday Nov 29 11:59 PM, with a generated plan on the calendar. Prompt "When is my CS 3354 Project due?" sent with POST /api/agent/chat, the message box on the AI Assistant page.
cases.expected: Reply identifies CS 3354 Project and its Sunday Nov 29 11:59 PM deadline accurately. No tasks or schedule blocks change.
cases.actual: 200, reply "Your CS 3354 Project is due on 2026-11-30 at 05:59 UTC. Its status is Not Started, and it's estimated at 60 minutes.". Tasks and blocks unchanged: True.

checks.check: chat answers 200
reply names CS 3354 Project
reply gives the due day (Sunday Nov 29)
reply gives the due time 11:59 PM
tasks rows unchanged
study_blocks rows unchanged

cases.title: Move a study block through chat
cases.requirement: UC-7 Interact with AI Chatbot, FR-20 (chatbot as a shortcut to create tasks or edit the schedule)
cases.inputs: CS 3354 Review scheduled Saturday Nov 28 4-5 PM and Other task Saturday Nov 28 6-7 PM (placed with PATCH /api/schedule/blocks, Edit Schedule); Sunday Nov 29 4-5 PM is free study time. Prompt "Move CS 3354 Review from Saturday 4-5 PM to Sunday 4-5 PM." sent with POST /api/agent/chat, the message box on the AI Assistant page. A yes is sent if the reply asks to confirm. Then GET /api/schedule as the reload.
cases.expected: One CS 3354 Review block appears Sunday Nov 29 4-5 PM, not Saturday Nov 28 4-5 PM. Other events remain unchanged; the new time persists after reload.
cases.actual: 200, reply "I can't move it myself, since I can only read your schedule. To change it, go to the schedule page in Cramberry and edit the Saturday 4:00 PM block for CS 3354 Review, setting it to Sunday 4:00 PM-5:00 PM. One thing to c...". CS 3354 Review after reload ['Sat 16:00-17:00'].

checks.check: chat answers 200
exactly one CS 3354 Review block, at Sun 16:00-17:00
no CS 3354 Review block at Sat 16:00-17:00
other events unchanged
new time persists in study_blocks rows

cases.title: Reject a nonexistent task update
cases.requirement: UC-7 Interact with AI Chatbot, FR-20 (chatbot as a shortcut to create tasks or edit the schedule)
cases.inputs: Task list has only CS 3354 Project, with a saved plan. Prompt "Move HIST 3300 Essay to tomorrow at 5 PM." sent with POST /api/agent/chat, the message box on the AI Assistant page. Then GET /api/tasks and GET /api/schedule as the reload.
cases.expected: Chatbot reports the task cannot be found or asks for a valid task. No task is fabricated, and the saved schedule is unchanged.
cases.actual: 200, reply "I can't make that change. I can only answer questions about your tasks and schedule, not edit them. To move the HIST 3300 Essay to tomorrow at 5 PM, use the schedule page in Cramberry and edit that study block there. Als...". Tasks after ['CS 3354 Project']; blocks unchanged: True.

checks.check: chat answers 200
reply says the task can't be found or asks for a valid task
no HIST 3300 Essay task exists
tasks rows unchanged
study_blocks rows unchanged

cases.title: Create and schedule a task via chat
cases.requirement: UC-7 Interact with AI Chatbot, FR-20 (chatbot as a shortcut to create tasks or edit the schedule)
cases.inputs: Study preferences free Saturday Nov 28 4-5 PM and Sunday Nov 29 4-7 PM, no tasks, empty calendar. Prompt "Add CHEM 1311 Chapter 5 Review due Sun 11:59 PM and schedule 60 minutes Sat 4-5 PM." sent with POST /api/agent/chat, the message box on the AI Assistant page. A yes is sent if the reply asks to confirm. Then GET /api/tasks and GET /api/schedule as the reload.
cases.expected: Exactly one task has the correct title and due time; one Saturday Nov 28 4-5 PM study block exists without conflict. Both persist after reload.
cases.actual: 200, reply "I can't add tasks or schedule blocks myself, since I only have read access to your data. To do this, go to the Tasks page to add "CHEM 1311 Chapter 5 Review" with a due date of Sunday at 11:59 PM, then go to the Study Sc...". Tasks after reload none; blocks none.

checks.check: chat answers 200
exactly one CHEM 1311 Chapter 5 Review task, due Sunday Nov 29 11:59 PM
exactly one block for it, at Sat 16:00-17:00
task and block persist in Supabase rows
